primary_sources.title: On the p-adic valuation of harmonic numbers
primary_sources.author: Carlo Sanna
primary_sources.exact_anchor: PDF p. 1, abstract and Introduction: defines J_p, records J_5={4,20,24}, and states that the Eswarathasan--Levine finiteness conjecture remains open. mechanism_comparison.classical_harmonic_object: J_p records indices where the numerator of H_K is divisible by p. Its finite-tree computation and p-adic descendants are established harmonic-number machinery.
mechanism_comparison.local_weighted_object: The recurrence application replaces H_K by a unit-weighted reciprocal sum. The continuity hypothesis forces this weighted sum to agree with g_* H_K modulo p.
mechanism_comparison.transfer: Outside J_p the weighted normalized quantity has valuation -1, so a finite J_p yields a permanent denominator divisor after its largest element.
mechanism_comparison.Wolstenholme_boundary: Wolstenholme explains the unavoidable early index p-1 in J_p for p>=5. It blocks a tail beginning before p-1 but says nothing against a tail beginning after max J_p.
mechanism_comparison.remaining_throat: For the q-Apéry specialization, the p=5 loss set and finite row replay are not the open issue; the all-index coefficient continuity/monodromy premise is. FixedPrimeInfiniteTailProof.md derives (C5) from (M), certifies (M) only for N=1,2,3, and explicitly leaves (M) at every level open.
mechanism_comparison.moving_prime_boundary: The separate primitive-tail census has explicit loss blocks and only finite start coverage. Its Lean declarations are conditional consumers for a common denominator divisor or a prime exterior-determinant witness; it does not supply those witnesses cofinally.
mechanism_comparison.window_probe_subordination: The exact window-divisor probe through starts 0..14 found a nontrivial gcd at every tested upper-half start and verified seven first-appearance prime divisibilities by 3^s-2^s. This is a finite diagnostic of the same denominator-tail theme, not an independent cofinal law: the fixed-prime conditional mechanism already supplies the correct all-index question, namely the recurrence-specific continuity premise.
